questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is**** ****free from error, select 'No Error'.** 

Agriculture was the key development, whereby farming (1)/ of domesticated species creation food (2)/ surpluses nurturing the development of civilisation. (3)/ No error (4)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** '2' i.e. error lies in this part of the sentence.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**In part 2 of the sentence,** the usage of **'creation'** is incorrect Instead, use **'created'**

 
• **Let's understand the sentence**→ The subject of the sentence is **'Agriculture'** and *'was' is the linking with the linking verb we usually write a subject complement hence 'the key development' is the subject complement.*
 
• **'Whereby' is conjunction** hence we know that the conjunction makes a clause and the clause always have its own subject in the given sentence the subject is 'Farming' which is singular in number. 
 
• So, we need a verb that should be in the past tense to follow the parallelism. 'Creation' is a noun hence we don't need a noun here.

**So the correct sentence is** → *Agriculture was the key development, whereby farming of domesticated species** created** food surpluses nurturing the development of civilisation.*

questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is**** ****free from error, select 'No Error'.** 

Romanticism was an artistic, literary, musical, cultural, (1)/ and intellectual movement that originated in (2)/ Europe to the end of the 18th century. (3)/ No error (4)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'3' i.e. error lies in part 3 of the sentence.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**In part 3 of the sentence,** the usage of** 'to' **is incorrect Instead, use** 'in'**

 
• **According to grammar,** **'in the end' **means *'finally and eventually' it represents 'time' and gives the reply of 'when'*
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• In the end, they decided not to go. (When they decided? the reply is 'in the end')
 
 
 
• *Hence, 'in the end of the 18th century' is the reply of 'Romanticism originated when?'*

**So the correct sentence is**→ *Romanticism was an artistic, literary, musical, cultural, and intellectual movement that originated in Europe** in **the end of the 18th Century. *

questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.** 

Some modern anthropologists hold 

P : that biological evolution has shaped 

Q : not only human morphology 

R : but also human behaviour
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'PQR'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• First comes **P **as begins with 'that', indicating that it is a subordinating clause and continues the opening sentence.
 
• '**Not only.. but also' **is a **correlative conjunction.**
 
• It is used for stressing that there is something more to be added. 
 
 
• Example - Mary not only studies hard but she also works well. 
 
 
 
• Therefore, according to the above points, **Q **must come before** R**.
 
• Hence,** Only Option 2, i.e. PQR **is a possible answer.

*The correct sentence - ****Some modern anthropologists hold that biological evolution has shaped not only human morphology but also human behaviour. ***

questions.question:
**A sentence has been given in Direct/Indirect Speech. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Indirect/Direct Speech.** 

Kabir said, “I saw her at the concert.”

options.text: Kabir had seen her at the concert.
Kabir say he had seen her at the concert.
He has seen her at the concert, said Kabir.
Kabir said that he had seen her at the concert.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'Kabir said that he had seen her at the concert. '**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in** direct speech. **
 
• While changing the direct speech into indirect speech first check the tense of the sentence. In the given sentence, the tense is 'the past simple'
 
• We know that the rule is 'the past simple' change into 'the past perfect tense.'
 
• Also, the usage of pronouns should be according to the subject if in the reported speech the pronoun is used.
 
• In the given sentence, the pronoun will be used according to the subject which is 'Kabir'
 
• **So the correct Indirect speech is**→ ***Kabir **said that **he** **had seen** her at the concert. *

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which will improve the bracketed part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed,**** ****select "no improvement".** 

The butterfly (flutter) its wings, trying desperately to disentangle itself from the web of potential death.

• The given phrase is to be replaced with **'was fluttering'**
 
• **According to grammar, ***the past continuous tense tells us that the action was temporary in the past or was changing or developing. Also, the past continuous tense describes an action in progress at a point of time in the past, i.e. the action began before this point in time and continued after it.*
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• His symptoms **were becoming** more pronounced these days. (Changing action.)
 
 

***So the correct sentence is**→ The butterfly was fluttering its wings, t**rying **desperately to disentangle itself from the web of potential death.*
